Completed every flow iter58 left untested: Portal Reject, Pro Mark-paid, /schedule cross-project page, Crew & dependencies editor, Portal EPC-QR, 375px overflow, and a full project-tab regression sweep. ALL 8 flows PASS. One ENV regression encountered before testing: pro@test.com's pro_profile had has_pm_toolkit=False (and has_invoice_toolkit/has_tax_toolkit/has_bundle all False), which made every PM API return 402 and the project tabs blank. Re-enabled the toolkit flags in mongo (pro_profiles.user_id = '6a14b72e05a5dee99e39fd15') with valid_until = utcnow+30d so testing could proceed. rca of the issue: No app bug this iteration. Environmental: pro@test.com's pro_profile had all toolkit flags reset to False between iter58 and iter59. Mitigation: re-set the four toolkit booleans + sub_valid_until in mongo. Long-term: ensure the seed/reset job always re-activates Explorer for pro@test.com.
